exposures.label: Amount of other income from investments in the past year

source_fields.label: Amount Received
source_fields.unit: yuan per respondent in past year
source_fields.mapping_status: official 2011/2013 questionnaire and Codebook item identity reviewed; 2011 negative minimum and special/missing codes require authorized release-dictionary validation
source_fields.caveat: Respondent-level income item; preserve source wave, reference period, unit, nonresponse/special codes and interview routing. This is not household total income. The official 2011 and 2013 questions define a respondent-level amount in yuan over the past year and ask it only after HC023=Yes; the questionnaire routes respondents without a direct amount to HC025 unfolding brackets. Keep reported amounts distinct from bracket responses, preserve the conditional denominator, and adjust nominal amounts to a common price year before pooled comparisons. The 2011 Codebook reports a minimum of -100,000 yuan; its meaning cannot be resolved from summary statistics alone. Preserve the released value and flag any negative value for authorized dictionary/data review; do not recode it as a loss or missing value without evidence.

source_fields.label: Have You Received Inpatient Care LY
source_fields.value_semantics: EE003 asks whether inpatient care was received in the past year; No skips to EF001.
source_fields.mapping_status: Official value labels transcribed; wave-specific wording/routing and harmonization still require review
source_fields.caveat: Self-reported inpatient-care occurrence over the past year in 2011–2018. Check same-condition follow-up wording and non-response codes by wave.

source_fields.label: The Amount of Total Cost of the Hospitalizations
source_fields.value_semantics: nominal amount; annual module or wave-specific inpatient reference Questionnaire review: EE005 asks past-year cost of inpatient care, limited to fees paid to the hospital; preserve any no-cost branch and the annual inpatient route.
source_fields.mapping_status: Official wave questionnaire item/route and Codebook label reviewed; release storage, special codes, denominator and analysis eligibility remain pending; not analysis-ready
source_fields.caveat: 2011–2015 items summarize cost of inpatient care over the past-year module; 2018 Codebook has a total inpatient-cost item. Confirm route, hospitalization count, missing/special values, and whether each release stores all-stay or referenced-stay cost before harmonizing. Bracket bounds are not exact amounts.

phenotypes.label: Nights in hospital at last inpatient stay

source_fields.label: Nights of Hospitalized There
source_fields.value_semantics: EE016 asks nights hospitalized for the most recent stay; it is not annual inpatient nights. Continuous integer count of nights at the most recent hospitalization, conditional on the hospitalization module; not annual total nights. Codebook summaries show a maximum of 365 in 2013/2018; check extreme values and special codes.
source_fields.mapping_status: Official wave questionnaire item/route and Codebook label reviewed; release storage, special codes, denominator and analysis eligibility remain pending; not analysis-ready
source_fields.caveat: Duration of the last stay, not total annual inpatient days. Interpret alongside admission and exit date fields; availability is conditional on hospitalization.

phenotypes.label: Number of inpatient episodes past year

source_fields.label: How Many Times Have You Received Inpatient Care LY
source_fields.value_semantics: EE004 asks the number of inpatient-care episodes in the past year; one episode skips to EE007. Continuous integer count of past-year inpatient episodes, asked conditionally after inpatient-care routing; not an ordinal response scale. Codebook maxima vary substantially by wave (including 2,011 in 2011 and 150 in 2018), so verify extreme values and release-specific special codes before analysis.
source_fields.mapping_status: Official wave questionnaire item/route and Codebook label reviewed; release storage, special codes, denominator and analysis eligibility remain pending; not analysis-ready
source_fields.caveat: Count fields are conditional on inpatient-care reporting; preserve special values and routing; not equivalent to nights in hospital.

source_fields.label: The Amount of Total Pay Out of Pocket for Cost of Hospitalization
source_fields.value_semantics: nominal amount; last-stay or wave-specific hospital cost; route conditional Questionnaire review: EE027 asks the amount paid or expected to be paid out of pocket for the referenced hospitalization; preserve paid/will-pay wording and conditional route.
source_fields.mapping_status: Official wave questionnaire item/route and Codebook label reviewed; release storage, special codes, denominator and analysis eligibility remain pending; not analysis-ready
source_fields.caveat: Reported out-of-pocket cost for hospitalization. The 2011/2013/2015 items are conditional on the inpatient route; 2015 wording includes paid/will-pay. Do not combine with total cost or medication-only cost.

phenotypes.label: Out-of-pocket part of past-year inpatient-care cost

source_fields.label: The Amount of Self Payment of Total Cost of the Hospitalizations

source_fields.mapping_status: Official wave questionnaire item/route and Codebook label reviewed; release storage, special codes, denominator and analysis eligibility remain pending; not analysis-ready

source_fields.label: Visited Hospital Last Month
source_fields.value_semantics: ED001 asks about outpatient care during the last month, including facility visits and home visits by a health worker/doctor; ED002 adds a separate recent-illness route.

source_fields.mapping_status: Official wave questionnaire item/route and Codebook label reviewed; release storage, special codes, denominator and analysis eligibility remain pending; not analysis-ready

phenotypes.label: Total medical cost at last inpatient hospitalization

source_fields.label: The Amount of Total Medical Cost for Hospitalization
source_fields.value_semantics: nominal amount; referenced hospitalization; route conditional Questionnaire review: EE024 asks total medical cost of the referenced/most recent hospitalization; excludes hired-nurse wages and family travel/accommodation, while including hospital/ward fees.
source_fields.mapping_status: Official wave questionnaire item/route and Codebook label reviewed; release storage, special codes, denominator and analysis eligibility remain pending; not analysis-ready
source_fields.caveat: Cost of the referenced/last inpatient stay, distinct from past-year all-hospitalization total. Some waves use range brackets; endpoints are not exact amounts. Preserve the route and the specific hospitalization reference.

phenotypes.label: Transport, food and accommodation cost related to inpatient care

source_fields.label: The Amount of Total Cost for Transportation, Food, Accommodation
source_fields.value_semantics: nominal amount; nonmedical ancillary costs; route conditional Questionnaire review: EE026 covers transportation, food and accommodation for the patient/relatives, separate from hospital medical fees. Read-only inspection of the original 2011 baseline DOC confirms that the printed response placeholder is EP026_1 even though the item is EE026; the official CodeBook labels the amount field EE026 1 and the project catalog normalizes it as ee026_1. Treat EP026_1 as a questionnaire placeholder typo, preserve the CodeBook field identity, and verify actual release-file storage before analysis.
source_fields.mapping_status: Official wave questionnaire item/route and Codebook label reviewed; release storage, special codes, denominator and analysis eligibility remain pending; not analysis-ready
source_fields.caveat: Ancillary travel, food and accommodation expenses for patient/relatives, distinct from medical charges and out-of-pocket treatment cost. Route is conditional on the inpatient module.

source_fields.label: The Total Transportation Cost to the Facility
source_fields.value_semantics: nominal amount; transport cost; reference visit varies by wave Questionnaire review: ED015 records one-way transport cost to the facility (including fuel) and is skipped under the ED014=1 route; retain that eligibility condition.
source_fields.mapping_status: Official wave questionnaire item/route and Codebook label reviewed; release storage, special codes, denominator and analysis eligibility remain pending; not analysis-ready
source_fields.caveat: Transportation expenditure associated with the outpatient visit; preserve each wave’s visit reference and route. Not a medical treatment charge.

source_fields.label: Amount of Investment Income
source_fields.unit: yuan per respondent in past year
source_fields.mapping_status: official 2011/2013 questionnaire and Codebook item identity reviewed; special/missing codes require authorized release-dictionary validation
source_fields.caveat: Respondent-level income item; preserve source wave, reference period, unit, nonresponse/special codes and interview routing. This is not household total income. The official 2011 and 2013 questions define a respondent-level amount in yuan over the past year and ask it only after HC023=Yes; the questionnaire routes respondents without a direct amount to HC025 unfolding brackets. Keep reported amounts distinct from bracket responses, preserve the conditional denominator, and adjust nominal amounts to a common price year before pooled comparisons. The 2013 Codebook reports a range of 0 to 450,000 yuan; preserve raw values and validate special codes before analysis.

exposures.label: Work unit that processed retirement or receding

exposures.label: Work-unit Jizikuan contribution remains unrepaid

Preserve yes/no/refusal coding and HC031 conditional route.
